fragrance_concept.smell_signature: This fragrance begins with a zesty citrus top that transitions into a rich, fruity floral heart, settling into a warm, leathery base. It evokes the scent of a high-end boutique store in the heart of a bustling city, where the aroma of leather goods mingles with the fresh scent of seasonal flowers.

note_guide.smells_like: currant bud black currant bud, natural
